title: Affine linear remainder
statement: Given $a_0\in\mathbb R$, coefficients $a_k\in\mathbb R$ for $k$ in a set of $n$ coordinates, a coordinate $i$, and a sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, the affine linear remainder at $i$ is $a_0+\sum_{k\ne i}a_k x_k$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ assigns a real coefficient to each of the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
